description: End-to-end YOLOv8 object detection pipeline for industrial bottle quality control on a simulated conveyor belt. Dataset built from scratch via manual image capture and annotation.

dataset.name: Big Cola Bottles Quality Control Dataset
dataset.source: Manually captured — physical bottles on a black-paper conveyor simulation

training_split.split_strategy: Grouped by original image stem — augmented versions always in same split as their source image (leakage-safe)

limitations: Trained on a simulated conveyor environment (black paper background) — may need fine-tuning for real factory lighting conditions
Small dataset (376 raw images) — performance on rare edge cases may degrade
3 missed detections observed on held-out test video — primarily low-contrast or partially occluded bottles
intended_use: Quality control detection of Big Cola bottle conditions on a conveyor belt. Classifies bottles as perfect, empty, missing cap, missing label, or crooked cap.
pipeline_notes: Six pipeline bugs were documented and fixed during development. Full post-mortem available in docs/engineering_debrief.md. Dataset fingerprinted with SHA-256 before training to ensure reproducibility.
